actual: Scope: validation.guardrails / issue workflow client prompts. BUG-fix workflows should stay lightweight by default. Ordinary BUG fixes must start from doctor, Context Pack, BUG JSON, allowed_write_scope, ownership catalog, and targeted code snippets. They should not read feature or architecture design documents unless the BUG explicitly cites a design, the user explicitly asks for historical/design context, or the task is classified as T3 architecture/design work. This change reduces token usage and avoids over-engineered repair paths while preserving feature-workflow design acceptance for real feature work.
closure_requirements: Keep BUG JSON and GitHub Issue synchronized.

Run targeted validation first, then final gates once the patch is stable.
Batch compatible workflow/CI/docs changes into one PR with per-issue evidence.
